Definition: (in the plural only) the kidneys (as being covered); hence (figuratively) the inmost thought
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses ṭuchâh where it means the inward parts, the kidneys. In Job 38:36, Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts, and it appears again in Psalms 51:6.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the inward parts God looks at are where truth lives, and Psalm 51 asks Him to make me true there.
